purpose: Curated historical eBay source observations for a future demo; not a live feed or simultaneous market snapshot.
notes: Titles, prices and condition were read from individual cached listing pages; source capture time is unknown. Access date is not the original capture date.
New black EOS R50 bodies only. EOS R50 V, white bodies, lens kits, used/refurbished units are excluded; one explicitly out-of-stock record is retained solely as a labelled historical candidate.
Product condition and configuration are seller claims. This collection task did not inspect goods, authenticate claims, or verify current stock.
Item-price-only comparison excludes shipping, taxes and import fees. Sellers span different regions; warranty, menu language, supplied power plug and regional terms have not been normalized.
The Red Tag listing says its lens may have been removed from a kit box; retain that caveat when deciding packaging equivalence.

Search snippets and opened pages sometimes disagree. This file consistently uses the opened cached page, without cherry-picking a lower search price. For example opened prices for Japan/Korea are 755.63/999.00 USD, whereas search excerpts showed 785.33/839.00 USD.
No median, risk score, current saving or live availability claim is supplied. Runtime is unchanged.

Additional US sources were checked: UniquePhoto explicitly claims one-year manufacturer warranty but is out of stock; BuyDig advertises Canon warranty but is also out of stock. Neither proves an available comparable pool.

All six records remain candidate_only for median computation. Crutchfield has a seller-profile manufacturer-warranty claim; other warranties and territories cannot be assumed equivalent. Historical listing display is allowed with status labels; median-ready pool remains unestablished.
